screenLevelIssues.explanation: Figma design uses a fixed Header (Frame 2095586357) and fixed Bottom Action Bar (Frame 1686557229) with scrollable content underneath. Implementation requires absolute positioning for header/footer and corresponding content padding on the ScrollView.
screenLevelIssues.fixedCode:
<View style={{flex:1, backgroundColor:'#131313'}}>
  <Header style={{position:'absolute', top:0, width:'100%', height:157, zIndex:10}} />
  <ScrollView contentContainerStyle={{paddingTop:157, paddingBottom:118}}>
    {/* Main Content */}
  </ScrollView>
  <BottomBar style={{position:'absolute', bottom:0, width:'100%', height:118, zIndex:5}} />
</View>

screenLevelIssues.explanation: The 'Payment Cards' section (Frame 2095586448) requires a horizontal ScrollView with specific content insets to match the design (Left padding 64px, Right padding 32px, Gap 16px).
screenLevelIssues.fixedCode:
<ScrollView horizontal contentContainerStyle={{paddingLeft: 64, paddingRight: 32, gap: 16}} showsHorizontalScrollIndicator={false}>
  {/* Cards */}
</ScrollView>

screenLevelIssues.explanation: The Header (Frame 2095586357) overlaps with the Status Bar/HW Cutout area in Figma. Implementation must apply top padding equal to the system safe area inset to prevent content overlap.

feedback.explanation: The screen requires a Z-layered layout with a fixed absolute Header and BottomBar, and a ScrollView with corresponding content padding. The file may need to be created.
The 'Payment Cards' section requires a horizontal ScrollView with specific spacing tokens matching Figma (Left: 64, Right: 32, Gap: 16).
feedback.fixedCode:
<ScrollView 
  horizontal 
  showsHorizontalScrollIndicator={false}
  contentContainerStyle={{
    paddingLeft: 64, // spacing.huge
    paddingRight: 32, // spacing.xl
    gap: 16 // spacing.md
  }}
>
  {/* Cards */}
</ScrollView>
